theorem QOU.Hecke.IsospinTwistFromBalancing.hecke_spin_only_split {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θS θI p p' : A) (q σ τ g g' f f' : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R q [4, 2] 6 g] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R q [3, 3] 6 g'] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R 1 [4, 2] 6 f] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R 1 [3, 3] 6 f'] (hS : θS * p = (σ ^ 6 * g) • p) (hS' : θS * p' = (σ ^ 6 * g') • p') (hI : θI * p = (τ ^ 6 * f) • p) (hI' : θI * p' = (τ ^ 6 * f') • p') :
tr (θS * p) * tr (θI * p') - tr (θS * p') * tr (θI * p) = σ ^ 6 * τ ^ 6 * (q ^ 10 - q ^ 6) * (tr p * tr p')

theorem QOU.Hecke.IsospinTwistFromBalancing.hecke_transparent_iff {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (t f f' : R) (ht : t ≠ 0) [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R t [4, 2] 6 f] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R t [3, 3] 6 f'] :
f = 1 ∧ f' = 1 ↔ t ^ 2 = 1

theorem QOU.Hecke.IsospinTwistFromBalancing.hecke_iso_eq_iff {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (t τ f f' : R) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hτ : τ ≠ 0) [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R t [4, 2] 6 f] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R t [3, 3] 6 f'] :
τ ^ 6 * f = τ ^ 6 * f' ↔ t ^ 4 = 1

theorem QOU.Hecke.IsospinTwistFromBalancing.hecke_same_parameter_no_split {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θS θI p p' : A) (q σ τ g g' f f' : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R q [4, 2] 6 g] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R q [3, 3] 6 g'] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R q [4, 2] 6 f] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R q [3, 3] 6 f'] (hS : θS * p = (σ ^ 6 * g) • p) (hS' : θS * p' = (σ ^ 6 * g') • p') (hI : θI * p = (τ ^ 6 * f) • p) (hI' : θI * p' = (τ ^ 6 * f') • p') :
tr (θS * p) * tr (θI * p') - tr (θS * p') * tr (θI * p) = 0

theorem QOU.Hecke.IsospinTwistFromBalancing.hecke_balanced_split {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θS θI p p' : A) (q t σ τ g g' f f' : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R q [4, 2] 6 g] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R q [3, 3] 6 g'] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R t [4, 2] 6 f] [BraidKnot.Keystone.JucysMurphySpectrum R t [3, 3] 6 f'] (hS : θS * p = (σ ^ 6 * g) • p) (hS' : θS * p' = (σ ^ 6 * g') • p') (hI : θI * p = (τ ^ 6 * f) • p) (hI' : θI * p' = (τ ^ 6 * f') • p') :
tr (θS * p) * tr (θI * p') - tr (θS * p') * tr (θI * p) = σ ^ 6 * τ ^ 6 * (q ^ 6 * t ^ 6 * (q ^ 4 - t ^ 4)) * (tr p * tr p')

theorem QOU.Hecke.IsospinTwistFromBalancing.transparent_iso_split {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θS θI p p' : A) (s s' τ : R) (hS : θS * p = s • p) (hS' : θS * p' = s' • p') (hI : θI * p = (τ ^ 6 * 1) • p) (hI' : θI * p' = (τ ^ 6 * 1) • p') :
tr (θS * p) * tr (θI * p') - tr (θS * p') * tr (θI * p) = τ ^ 6 * (s - s') * (tr p * tr p')

theorem QOU.Hecke.IsospinTwistFromBalancing.balanced_iso_eq_iff {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (τ f f' : R) (hτ : τ ≠ 0) :

theorem QOU.Hecke.IsospinTwistFromBalancing.balanced_split {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θS θI p p' : A) (σ τ g g' f f' : R) (hS : θS * p = (σ ^ 6 * g) • p) (hS' : θS * p' = (σ ^ 6 * g') • p') (hI : θI * p = (τ ^ 6 * f) • p) (hI' : θI * p' = (τ ^ 6 * f') • p') :
tr (θS * p) * tr (θI * p') - tr (θS * p') * tr (θI * p) = σ ^ 6 * τ ^ 6 * (g * f' - g' * f) * (tr p * tr p')
